pack.linkedin:
Stock markets have had a turbulent week with tech shares swinging wildly and investors reassessing corporate profits. When the tech heavy Nasdaq takes a brutal hit, it is easy for everyday savers to feel unsettled by the noise.

Closer to home, the economic reality is clear. Euro area inflation stands at 4%, while new term deposit rates in Portugal average 1.83%. Simple math tells us that keeping all your cash in a standard savings account means your money is slowly losing purchasing power.

Markets always move in cycles. The best defense against volatility is understanding the numbers and keeping a long term perspective. Don't let headline panic derail your personal financial goals.
